sources.notes: NYC Building Energy and Water Data Disclosure for Local Law 84, 2023 to Present (data for calendar years 2022-present), dataset 5zyy-y8am, 103,259 rows. Requested columns are the property ID, BBL list, EPA property type and the energy, emissions and floor-area figures; property name, address, coordinates and the many per-use columns are not requested. The Tyler/Socrata platform terms are in tension with bulk export (see ny-nyc-dof and docs/registry/requests/platform-terms/socrata.md); the agency licence is relied on. data.cityofnewyork.us robots.txt: Crawl-delay 1; only /browse search pages disallowed.
